basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old living in Seattle, Washington, working as a junior software developer. I've recently started exploring Reddit to dive deeper into my interests in sci-fi shows like Star Trek as well as video game development, particularly using tools like Pygame. I play the saxophone in my spare time and enjoy collecting vintage plaid clothing. My online hours are mostly evenings and weekends since I work a 9-to-5 job. I’m currently single and enjoy meeting new people online through shared interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from a local university and have been programming since high school. My interest in sci-fi started with watching Star Trek reruns with my parents. Recently, I've been teaching myself game development using resources from various online communities.
